sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.dept.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT D.DEPT_CD, UPPER_DEPT, CASE WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 01 THEN 0 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 02 THEN 1 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 03 THEN 2 WHEN DEPT_TYPE = 04 THEN 3 END DEPT_LEVEL, -- DEPT_LEVEL ISNULL((SELECT 'N' FROM MS_DEPT DD WHERE DD.UPPER_DEPT = D.DEPT_CD -- AND DD.USE_YN ='Y' GROUP BY DD.UPPER_DEPT), 'Y') AS LEAF_YN, DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN DEPT_TYPE >= 04 THEN DEPT_NAME + ' (' + D.DEPT_CD + ')' ELSE D.DEPT_NAME END AS DEPT_NAME2, -- CASE WHEN DEPT_LEVEL >= 3 THEN CONCAT(DEPT_NAME ,' (' , D.DEPT_CD , ')' ) ELSE D.DEPT_NAME END AS DEPT_NAME2, D.USE_YN, D.ORG1_CD, D.ORG2_CD, D.ORG3_CD, D.ORG4_CD, D.SORT_NO AS ANL_USE_YN, D.CHG_ID, UM.USER_NAME as CHG_NAME, CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) CHG_TIME FROM MS_DEPT D LEFT OUTER JOIN MS_USERMASTER UM ON D.CHG_ID = UM.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 ?schCode ?schName ORDER BY UPPER_DEPT, D.DEPT_CD

sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.dept.sel.excel
sql-service.query: SELECT (SELECT DEPT_NAME from ms_dept b where a.org1_cd = b.DEPT_CD) ORG1_NAME, (SELECT DEPT_NAME from ms_dept b where a.org2_cd = b.DEPT_CD) ORG2_NAME, a.DEPT_NAME, a.DEPT_CD FROM ms_dept a WHERE a.DEPT_TYPE = 04 -- WHERE a.DEPT_LEVEL = 3 ?use_yn order by org1_name, org2_name, DEPT_NAME

sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.deptinfo.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY D.DEPT_CD DESC) AS RNUM ,ISNULL((SELECT 'N' FROM ms_dept DD WHERE DD.UPPER_DEPT = D.DEPT_CD GROUP BY DD.UPPER_DEPT), 'Y') AS LEAF_YN ,D.DEPT_CD ,'' AS MAPP_DEPT_CD ,'' AS NEXT_CENTER_CD ,'' AS OLD_UPPER_DEPT ,'' AS OLD_ORG1_CD ,'' AS OLD_ORG2_CD ,'' AS OLD_ORG3_CD ,'' AS OLD_ORG4_CD , CASE WHEN D.DEPT_TYPE = 01 THEN 0 WHEN D.DEPT_TYPE = 02 THEN 1 WHEN D.DEPT_TYPE = 03 THEN 2 WHEN D.DEPT_TYPE = 04 THEN 3 END DEPT_LEVEL --,D.DEPT_LEVEL ,D.UPPER_DEPT ,D.SORT_NO AS ANL_USE_YN ,'' AS NEXT_CENTER_SORT_NO ,D.DEPT_NAME ,D.DEPT_NAME DEPT_NAME2 ,D.USE_YN ,D.ORG1_CD ,D.ORG2_CD ,D.ORG3_CD ,D.ORG4_CD ,D.CHG_ID ,UM.USER_NAME AS CHG_NAME ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(), 112) AS CHG_TIME FROM ms_dept D ,ms_usermaster UM WHERE UM.USER_ID = D.CHG_ID AND D.DEPT_CD = ?dept_cd

sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.sortno.upd01
sql-service.query: UPDATE cs_dept D SET D.SORT_NO = ?target_sort_no WHERE D.DEPT_CD = ?target_dept_cd

sql-service.query: UPDATE cs_dept D SET D.SORT_NO = ?self_sort_no WHERE D.DEPT_CD = ?self_dept_cd

sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.dept.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO cs_dept ( DEPT_CD ,DEPT_NAME ,DEPT_ENAME ,UPPER_DEPT ,ORG1_CD ,ORG2_CD ,ORG3_CD ,ORG4_CD ,DEPT_LEVEL ,USE_YN ,TEL_NO1 ,TEL_NO2 ,COMPANY_CD ,START_DATE ,END_DATE ,SORT_NO ,DEPT_INFO ,WORK_GROUP_CD ,CHG_ID ,CHG_TIME ) VALUES ( ?dept_cd ,?dept_name ,?dept_ename ,?upper_dept ,IFNULL(?org1_cd, ?dept_cd ) ,?org2_cd ,?org3_cd ,?org4_cd ,?dept_level ,?use_yn ,?tel_no1 ,?tel_no2 ,?company_cd ,?start_date ,?end_date ,(SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SORT_NO), 0) + 1 MAX_SORT_NO FROM cs_dept D WHERE DEPT_LEVEL = ?dept_level AND IFNULL(UPPER_DEPT, ' ') = IFNULL(?upper_dept, ' ')) ,?dept_info ,?work_group_cd ,?chg_id ,DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )

sql-service.name: wfm.hr.hrm100m010p.deptupd.ins
sql-service.query: INSERT INTO cs_dept_upd( DEPT_CD , SEQ , UPD_DATE , UPPER_DEPT , ORG1_CD , ORG2_CD , ORG3_CD , ORG4_CD , ORG5_CD , ORG6_CD , OLD_UPPER_DEPT , OLD_ORG1_CD , OLD_ORG2_CD , OLD_ORG3_CD , OLD_ORG4_CD , OLD_ORG5_CD , OLD_ORG6_CD , CHG_ID , CHG_TIME ) VALUES ( ?dept_cd , CS_DEPT_UPD_SQ.NEXTVAL , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') , ?upper_dept , NVL(?org1_cd, ?dept_cd) , ?org2_cd , ?org3_cd , ?org4_cd , ?org5_cd , ?org6_cd , '' , '' , '' , '' , '' , '' , '' , ?chg_id , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )

sql-service.name: cs.hr.hrm110m10p.sel.dept
sql-service.query: SELECT DEPT_CD, UPPER_DEPT, ISNULL((SELECT 'N' FROM ms_dept DD WHERE DD.UPPER_DEPT = D.DEPT_CD AND DD.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY DD.UPPER_DEPT), 'Y') AS LEAF_YN, DEPT_NAME ,dbo.GET_DEPT_FULLNAME(D.DEPT_CD) DEPT_FULLNAME FROM ms_dept D WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY dept_level, dept_cd

sql-service.name: cs.hr.hrm110m20p.dept

sql-service.name: cs.hr.hrm120m.personlist.sel
sql-service.query: SELECT B.USER_ID ,B.EMP_NO ,B.USER_NAME ,A.ORG1_CD ,A.ORG1_NAME ,A.ORG2_CD ,A.ORG2_NAME ,A.ORG3_CD ,A.ORG3_NAME ,B.USER_GRADE_CD ,A.USER_GRADE_NM ,isnull(B.ENTER_DATE,'') AS ENTER_DATE ,isnull(B.RETIRE_DATE,'') AS RETIRE_DATE ,CASE WHEN B.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN '재직' ELSE '퇴사' END USE_YN ,isnull(A.WORK_MONTH,'') WORK_MONTH FROM vw_usermaster A, ms_usermaster B, ms_dept C WHERE A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL ?P_ORG1_CD ?P_ORG2_CD ?P_ORG3_CD ?USER_ID ?USER_NAME ?EMP_NO ?USER_GRADE_CD ?USE_YN ORDER BY A.DEPT_CD, B.USER_NAME

sql-service.query: SELECT 'U' SAVE_MODE ,'0' CHG_PWD ,M.USER_ID ,M.USER_NAME ,M.EMP_NO ,M.USER_GRADE_CD ,M.DEPT_CD ,D.ORG1_CD ,D.ORG2_CD ,D.ORG3_CD ,GET_DEPT_FULLNAME(M.DEPT_CD) DEPT_FULLNAME ,M.ENTER_DATE ,M.USE_YN ,M.WORK_GROUP_CD ,M.DEGREE ,M.PASSWORD ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM cs_usermaster C WHERE C.USER_ID=M.CHG_ID) CHG_ID ,M.CHG_TIME FROM cs_usermaster M LEFT OUTER JOIN cs_dept D ON M.dept_cd = D.dept_cd WHERE M.USER_ID=?user_id
